ओह गॉड! क्या साई पल्लवी को मिल गया है उनके सपनों का राजकुमार या अभी चल रही है तलाश? 😲
साई पल्लवी इन दिनों अपनी आने वाली फिल्म Ramayana Part 1 के प्रमोशन में बिजी हैं और हाल ही में वह Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 के सेट पर पहुंचीं।
शो के दौरान होस्ट अमिताभ बच्चन के सवाल पर साई ने बताया कि उन्हें ऐसा पार्टनर चाहिए जो खुदगर्ज न हो, अपनी गलतियों को माने और खाना बनाना जानता हो।
डॉक्टर की पढ़ाई के बाद एक्टिंग में आने के सवाल पर साई ने कहा कि भगवान ने उनके लिए यही लिखा था, जिस पर रणबीर कपूर ने मजाक में कहा कि वह 'भगवान का prescription' था।
Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बन रही इस फिल्म का बजट ₹ 4,000 crore बताया जा रहा है और यह 5 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी।
तो दोस्तों, क्या आप भी साई पल्लवी की इन शर्तों से सहमत हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में जरूर बताओ! 🎬✨

ctx.title: Sai Pallavi says she wants a life partner who is not self-centered, owns up to his mistakes and knows how to cook
ctx.summary: Sai Pallavi was on Kaun Banega Crorepati 18, where host Amitabh Bachchan asked her what are the qualities she wants in a life partners when she marries.
ctx.text:
All eyes are on Sai Pallavi as she gears up for the release for the highly anticipated Ramayana Part 1, which sees her Goddess Sita. The actor has been busy promoting the film, and recently was seen on Kaun Banega Crorepati 18, along with co-stars Ranbir Kapoor and Ravie Dubey. During the episode, host Amitabh Bachchan asked her about the qualities in a man she would want to be in her life partner.
In response, Sai said, “Pehle achche insaan hone chahiye (Firstly he should be a good man). He should not be very self-centred. He should be someone who is introspective. One who checks on his actions. So someone who has some insight about where he is in life… he can make mistakes but he must mend it too. It should not be that he is blaming it on someone else. It is not that there is a huge list but he should be a good person and it would be better if he also knows how to cook!”
In the episode, Amitabh also asked Sai about her decision to pursue acting after studying medicine. She replied, “God wrote it that you act,” suggesting that she was destined to become an actor. Her response left the host perplexed, prompting Ranbir to add a humorous twist to her explanation. “Bhagwan ka prescription tha Sir (God wrote in his prescription) that she has to act,” he said, drawing cheers and applause from the audience.
In another promo, Sai opened up about her initial reaction when she was offered the role of Sita in Ramayana. She said, “I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think, 'What can I give to that character? ' but this was the first time when I thought, 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think about anything. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari , the mythological epic stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravie Dubey as Lakshmana, Yash as Ravana and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The cast also includes Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Kajal Aggarwal and Vivek Oberoi in key roles.
Reportedly mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore, the film is backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra and is planned as a two-part franchise. The first instalment is scheduled to release in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part expected to arrive around Diwali 2027.
